src='''def transform(grid):
    g = [r[:] for r in grid]
    H, W = len(g), len(g[0])
    anchors = []
    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(W):
            if g[r][c] not in (0, 5):
                anchors.append((r, c, g[r][c]))
    left = min(anchors, key=lambda a: a[1])
    right = max(anchors, key=lambda a: a[1])
    rows = [r for r in range(H) if g[r].count(5) >= 2]
    cols = [c for c in range(W) if any(g[r][c] == 5 for r in range(H))]
    r0, r1 = min(rows), max(rows)
    c0, c1 = min(cols), max(cols)
    # block (br,bc) takes color of the anchor on the same side and same vertical half
    mid = (r0 + r1) / 2
    def color(br, bc):
        if bc == 0:
            return left[2] if (left[0] <= mid) == (br == 0) else right[2]
        else:
            return right[2] if (right[0] <= mid) == (br == 0) else left[2]
    for br, rr in enumerate(range(r0 + 1, r1, 2)):
        for bc, cc in enumerate(range(c0 + 1, c1, 2)):
            col = color(br, bc)
            for dr in range(2):
                for dc in range(2):
                    g[rr + dr][cc + dc] = col
    return g
'''
